相关性: 该论文将深度学习CNN模型应用于生物打印中的球体活力预测，直接实现质量控制自动化，与AI生物打印方向高度相关。

动机· 现有球体活力检测方法耗时且主观，需自动化非侵入式评估方法。

Motivation· Current spheroid viability assays are time-consuming and subjective, necessitating an automated non-invasive assessment method.
Method· A convolutional neural network was developed to predict spheroid viability categories from phase-contrast images.
Result· The model achieved an average accuracy of 92% with consistent loss below 0.2.
Validation· Validation was performed using a dataset of mouse mesenchymal stem cell spheroids with CCK-8 assay ground truth.

相关性: 该论文直接研究了多孔金属支架与骨之间的力学相互作用，包括应力遮挡和刚度匹配，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication details, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization.
动机· 研究多孔金属支架对骨应力分布的影响，以减少应力遮挡。
方法· 结合数字图像相关实验与有限元分析，评估不同孔隙率和材料对骨应变的影响。
结果· 多孔支架使骨应变更接近完整骨，Ti6Al4V优于CoCrMo，大孔隙更有效。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate how porous metal scaffolds affect bone stress distribution to mitigate stress shielding in orthopedic implants.
Method· An integrated approach combining digital image correlation experiments on bovine bone-scaffold constructs with finite element analysis and an analytical spring model.
Result· Porous scaffolds, especially Ti6Al4V with 1000 µm pores, produced bone strain and reaction forces closer to intact bone compared to solid scaffolds.
Validation· Experimental compression tests on bovine cortical bone with inserted scaffolds validated the finite element predictions.

边界: This paper does not include fatigue testing or surface roughness characterization, which are core aspects of the user's direction.
动机· 梯度多孔支架可模拟骨组织孔隙过渡，但免疫反应影响骨整合。
方法· SLM制备TPMS梯度多孔钛合金支架，评估力学与免疫调节性能。
结果· 梯度支架弹性模量与骨匹配，促进M2型巨噬细胞极化和成骨分化。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Gradient microporous scaffolds mimic the pore transition of bone but immune-inflammatory responses can impair osseointegration.
Method· Selective laser melting was used to fabricate Ti6Al4V gradient TPMS scaffolds with pore sizes from 650 to 350 μm, and mechanical testing, in vitro macrophage polarization, and in vivo implantation were performed.
Result· The gradient scaffold exhibited bone-matching elastic modulus, reduced stress shielding, promoted M2 macrophage polarization, and enhanced new bone formation in vivo.
Validation· Validation included mechanical testing, in vitro cell assays (macrophage polarization and osteogenic differentiation), and in vivo rat implantation with histological analysis.

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem pubmed Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation Patient-specific
Guo-Sen Li, Hao Li, Da Liu, Rui Yi, Yi Cui et al. Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology 2025-01-01 10.3389/fbioe.2025.1642787
单位: Department of Orthopaedics, The 908th Hospital of Joint Logistic Support Force, Nanchang, Jiangxi, China.; Third Clinical Medical College of Nanchang University, Jiangxi Medical College, Nanchang Univ
通讯: Jiang-Jun Zhou @ Department of Orthopaedics, The 908th Hospital of Joint Logistic Support Force, Nanchang, Jiangxi, China. [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接评估了3D打印钛合金假体在股骨缺损中的生物力学性能，包括应力遮挡和早期负重能力，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper focuses on diaphyseal defects rather than femoral stem implants, and does not quantify micromotion or contact mechanics at the bone-implant interface.
动机· 解决临界股骨干缺损的快速康复需求，评估个性化假体的生物力学性能。
方法· 通过生物力学测试和有限元分析，比较两种假体与完整股骨的轴向压缩、扭转、弯曲刚度和疲劳性能。
结果· 假体组与完整股骨压缩刚度无显著差异，应力低于屈服强度，多孔支架设计降低应力遮挡。
验证· 机械测试（压缩、扭转、弯曲、疲劳）结合数字图像相关验证应力分布。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the biomechanical performance of personalized 3D-printed titanium prostheses for critical femoral diaphyseal defects, aiming to enable early weight-bearing and rapid rehabilitation.
Method· Integrated biomechanical testing (axial compression, torsion, four-point bending, cyclic fatigue) and finite element analysis were performed on fourth-generation composite femurs with 10 cm defects, comparing two prosthesis designs against intact bones and diaphyseal fractures.
Result· Both prostheses achieved compressive stiffness comparable to intact femurs, with von Mises stresses below the yield strength of Ti6Al4V, and the porous scaffold design reduced stress shielding; prostheses withstood 100,000 cycles at 1800 N without failure.
Validation· Mechanical testing (stiffness, fatigue) and digital image correlation validated the FEA-predicted stress distribution patterns.

动机· 减少髋关节假体植入后的应力遮挡效应，延长假体寿命。
方法· 结合有限元分析与代理模型（MLP神经网络）优化假体位置参数。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To minimize stress shielding after hip prosthesis implantation by optimizing prosthesis positioning.
Method· A surrogate model (5×1 MLP neural network) is trained on finite element simulations to predict the stress shielding index, and genetic algorithms are used to optimize five positional parameters.
Result· The optimized prosthesis placement reduces the stress shielding index by 12% and brings post-implant stress distribution closer to the pre-implant state.
Validation· The optimization results are compared with the best initial design samples from a design of experiments.

Motivation· To mitigate cell damage caused by shear stress during extrusion-based bioprinting by optimizing key printing parameters.
Method· Systematically evaluated the effects of bioink viscosity, nozzle size, nozzle shape, and printing speed on post-printing cell viability.
Result· Higher viscosity bioinks and smaller cylindrical nozzles reduced cell viability due to increased shear stress, while translational flow speed had cell-type-dependent effects.
Validation· Cell viability assays were performed to validate the influence of each parameter on printed cell-laden constructs.

Motivation· To reduce costly experiments by developing in silico models that predict bone-implant interactions for biodegradable and permanent implants.

Motivation· To investigate the effects of sandblasting and acid etching post-processing on the surface properties of additively manufactured titanium and their impact on osteoblast adhesion.
Method· Additively manufactured and machined titanium samples were sandblasted at two pressures (2 bar and 6 bar) followed by acid etching; surface roughness, morphology, wettability, and osteoblast adhesion were characterized.
Result· Acid etching created irregular surface patterns with minimal change in overall roughness; all surfaces were highly hydrophilic immediately after etching, but storage in ambient air increased hydrophobicity over time, while NaCl storage preserved hydrophilicity and marginally improved biocompatibility.
Validation· Surface properties were validated using optical profilometry, SEM, contact angle measurements, and osteoblast adhesion was assessed via confocal microscopy and LDH assay.

Motivation· To address stress shielding and poor osseointegration of titanium implants by designing porous Ti6Al4V with bone-matching modulus.
Method· Porous Ti6Al4V foams were fabricated via coagulant-assisted metal foaming using egg white protein and citric acid, followed by controlled oxidation.

Motivation· To evaluate the biomechanical behavior of four osseointegrated prosthetic designs using finite element analysis to inform clinical application and design optimization.
Method· Three-dimensional finite element models were constructed for four prosthetic configurations (threaded, smooth press-fit, titanium alloy with multi-porous surface, and Mo-Re alloy with multi-porous surface) under simulated physiological loading.
Result· Multi-porous surfaces reduced stress concentration on the inner cortical wall; the Mo-Re alloy prosthesis showed reduced deformation and lower peak stress in the porous section (5.3 MPa vs. 9.3 MPa for titanium).
Validation· The study is purely computational with no experimental validation.

Method· Functionally graded and uniform porous PEEK were fabricated via infiltration casting, and their mechanical behavior and osseointegration were assessed through compression/bending tests, in vitro assays, and rabbit femur implantation.

Motivation· Standard Bayesian optimization treats the system as a black-box, limiting the exploitation of structural knowledge such as physics and interconnections.
Method· This work implements the BOIS framework, which uses adaptive linearizations of the composite function to obtain analytical expressions for statistical moments.
Result· BOIS performs as well as or better than existing grey-box methods on chemical process optimization benchmarks while being less computationally intensive.
Validation· Validation is performed via two numerical case studies in chemical process optimization and design.

Motivation· To reduce the computational cost of Bayesian neural networks for active learning in materials and chemicals property space.

Motivation· To simulate intraoperative femoral fractures during cementless stem insertion and assess fracture risk related to stem design.

Motivation· To investigate how fluoride concentration and pH affect titanium particle release from Ti6Al4V dental implants and subsequent macrophage responses.

Motivation· Conventional 2D culture fails to replicate the 3D structure of implants, necessitating a more physiologically relevant dynamic culture model for osseointegration research.
Method· Rat osteoblasts were cultured with vertically positioned dental implants in a 3D rotator with controlled tilting, and the effects of rotation speed, surface topography, and biochemical modulation were evaluated.
Result· Optimal cell attachment and proliferation occurred at 30 rpm; acid-etched hydrophilic and sandblasted surfaces enhanced ALP activity and mineralization, and N-acetyl cysteine further increased differentiation.
Validation· In vitro validation via cell attachment assays, proliferation, ALP activity, and mineralized matrix staining.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the biomechanical effects of metal block augmentation in medial opening wedge high tibial osteotomy under various lateral hinge fracture conditions.
Method· A finite element model of the proximal tibia was developed from CT data of a 62-year-old female, and simulations were run for uniplanar and biplanar osteotomies with and without a 12 mm metal block, including three Takeuchi fracture types.
Result· Metal block reduced micromotion by over 90% and proximal tibial stress by 21%-28%, but increased plate stress by up to 237%, indicating a stress-shielding effect.
Validation· The study is purely computational; no experimental validation was performed.

Motivation· To identify specific gene expression patterns that can serve as reliable biomarkers for predicting successful dental implant osseointegration.
Method· A systematic review and meta-analysis following PRISMA guidelines, synthesizing studies from PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science published between January 2020 and May 2025.
Result· Successful osseointegration is associated with upregulation of osteogenic genes like RUNX2, while implant failure correlates with elevated inflammatory cytokines and an imbalanced RANKL/OPG ratio.
Validation· Meta-analysis of a subset of homogeneous in vitro studies provided quantitative summary estimates of gene expression differences.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate whether mechanical forces from dental implants with different primary stabilities affect the osteoimmune response and macrophage polarization.
Method· An in vivo rat implantation model with varying implant stability was established, and external compressive force was applied to RAW264.7 cells in vitro to observe polarization and osteogenic differentiation.
Result· Compressive force initially induced both M1 and M2 macrophage polarization and later promoted transition to M2, relieving the suppressive effect of macrophages on osteogenesis.
Validation· In vivo rat model and in vitro cell culture experiments with RAW264.7 and MC3T3-E1 cells.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To reduce stress shielding from orthopedic plates by using a lower modulus TiNbSn alloy to enhance fracture healing.
Method· TiNbSn alloy plates with Young's modulus 40-49 GPa were applied in a rat femoral fracture model, compared with CP-Ti plates, with micro-CT, mechanical testing, and finite element analysis.
Result· TiNbSn plates significantly increased bone volume, mineral density, maximum load (77.2 vs 53.3 N), and stiffness, while reducing stress shielding and promoting interfragmentary movement.
Validation· Validation via micro-CT imaging, biomechanical testing, and finite element simulation.
